description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tribal Forcemage, adding {1}.
When Tribal Forcemage dies, Yedora triggers, returning Tribal Forcemage from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Tribal Forcemage by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Tribal Forcemage's morph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Tribal Forcemage triggers, giving creatures of a chosen creature type +2/+2 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
